people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ittai
people.line: Gittite commander who remained loyal to David.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, “Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom.” All the people heard when the king commanded all the captains concerning Absalom.
translations.bsb: Now the king had commanded Joab, Abishai, and Ittai, “Treat the young man Absalom gently for my sake.” And all the people heard the king’s orders to each of the commanders regarding Absalom.
translations.kjv: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.
translations.asv: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.
